Scoring that puts your job first
So what is Resume scoring?
Resume scoring uses artificial intelligence to evaluate candidate resumes against job-specific criteria. Instead of keyword filters, the AI analyzes each resume for relevant skills and experience, assigning a transparent, comparable score that helps recruiters shortlist candidates faster while reducing bias.
Say goodbye to keyword games. Unlike keyword-based resume screening tools, our AI creates customized scoring criteria based on your job description. This way, each resume is scored on skills and experience the role needs.
A fair, consistent way to screen resumes
Give each and every candidate a fair evaluation with one comparable score based on customizable criteria.
